findings.finding: Spaces around Latin runs (macOS 已关闭 Local Operator 的) contradict the zh-CN guide (no space) and most of the corpus (139 vs 5), but match the ui.browser* siblings (从 Chrome Web Store, 中的 {site} 未完成). No change; a corpus-wide call.
隐私与安全性 differs from core zh-CN cli.permissions (隐私与安全); 隐私与安全性 is the auditor’s recollection of Apple’s macOS 13+ pane name. The Apple zh-cn help page returned HTTP 429, so not verified here.

independence: Independent auditor (team lopdev task child, session d1da94af17b7); translator was agent coder. Same served model family as the translator (anthropic/claude-opus-5-5) — independence is by agent instance. No MT service, translation API or SDK used.
